Agent Name: Planner
, Step Number: 3
, Reason for Mistake: The Planner misinterpreted the task by using each film’s infobox “Country” (production country) as a proxy for the director’s nationality. This conflated film production country (US vs Germany) with the directors’ countries of origin. Had the Planner checked the directors’ nationalities, they would have found both Curtis Bernhardt and Carl Boese are German, yielding the correct answer “yes.”
